subject: Hosted API pricing qualification: expected monthly token volume + peak TPS
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@finedge.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 15 Jan 2026 16:02:00 -0800
Subject: Hosted API pricing qualification: expected monthly token volume + peak TPS

Hi Sarah — great to chat earlier. Quick recap and next steps on pricing so we can put together a tailored Hosted API quote.

Summary of what we discussed:
- Use case: customer support summarization + reranking + short chat for agents (mostly prompt lengths ~200-600 tokens).
- Current goals: deploy a pilot with 10k weekly active users, then scale to ~50k WAUs over 6 months.
- Key numbers we need to confirm: expected monthly token volume (in tokens/month) and expected peak TPS (tokens/sec or requests/sec during peak).

Open items for you:
1) Can you confirm an estimated monthly token volume range (low/likely/high)?
2) What is your target peak TPS (or peak requests/sec with avg token/request)?
3) Do you have a target unit-economics goal ($ per 1M tokens) or monthly budget range to hit?

For reference, our Hosted API pricing starts at $X per 1M tokens for base models; we generally recommend budgeting using per-1M-token tiers. Based on similar customers, here are ballpark unit economics:
- 1M tokens ~ $10–$40 depending on model/throughput/SLAs.
- We can provide committed monthly volume pricing for predictable unit costs.

Next steps:
- If you can send a 3-point estimate for monthly tokens and a peak TPS number, I’ll run model/modeled cost scenarios and send a tailored quote + a simple MLP (mutual action plan).

Attachments: redwood_pricing_sheet_v2.pdf (pricing summary)

Thanks — Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai
(415) 555-0132

From: Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@finedge.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 16 Jan 2026 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Hosted API pricing qualification: expected monthly token volume + peak TPS

Thanks Ben — quick answers below after checking with product/infra:

- Monthly tokens (3-point): low 30M, likely 75M, high 200M (these include both user prompts and model outputs; avg tokens/request ~450).
- Peak: around 18 req/s at peak hours. With avg 450 tokens/request that’s ~8100 tokens/sec -> ~29k tokens/sec? Wait math: 18 req/s * 450 tokens = 8,100 tokens/sec. Sorry earlier typo.
- Budget: we’re aiming for $8–$15 per 1M tokens as our internal target (prefer closer to $10 if possible). Pilot budget is modest (low 4-figures/month) with intention to scale to mid 5-figures if unit economics work.

We attached a rough usage forecast: finedge_token_estimates.xlsx

Happy to hop on a short follow-up if you want to run scenarios.

—Sarah
Sarah Liu
Head of Product, FinEdge
sarah.liu@finedge.com

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@finedge.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 16 Jan 2026 09:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Hosted API pricing qualification: expected monthly token volume + peak TPS

Thanks Sarah — that’s super helpful. Quick checks and notes:
- Monthly tokens: we’ll model using the likely 75M and stress with 200M as worst-case.
- Peak TPS: your number converts to ~8.1k tokens/sec (18 req/s * 450 tokens/request). For Hosted API, that’s well within typical capacity but we’ll size concurrency accordingly.
- Target unit economics: $8–$15 per 1M tokens — we can likely get into the $10–12 range with a modest committed volume and a short pilot commit.

Marissa — looping you in to confirm pricing ranges and whether we can offer an intro pilot rate to hit Sarah’s $10 target for the first 1–2 months.

Next steps:
- I’ll put together 2 scenarios (pilot: 75M/mo @ $12/1M & scale: 200M/mo @ $9/1M) and share a short cost table.
- Sarah — if you can confirm the expected duration of the pilot and any SLA requirements, we’ll align on MLP and potential short-term credits.

Ben

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@finedge.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 19 Jan 2026 08:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Hosted API pricing qualification: expected monthly token volume + peak TPS

Hi Sarah — happy to help with numbers. A couple clarifications from pricing ops:

- For a pilot at ~75M tokens/month we can offer $11/1M tokens for the first 60 days (intro pilot rate). That gets you closer to the $10 target you mentioned.
- If you commit to a quarterly reserved volume of 200M+/month we can get to $8.50–$9.50/1M depending on model family and SLA.
- Peak TPS considerations: given ~8k tokens/sec we recommend configuring a bursty concurrency policy instead of a large reserved throughput pool — that keeps costs predictable and supports sudden peaks.

I’ve attached the latest pricing sheet and a short mutual action plan template. If this looks good we can prepare an MSA + SOW and a short DocuSign for a pilot order (no long-term lock unless you want reserved pricing).

Attachments: redwood_pricing_sheet_v2.pdf

Best,
Marissa Cole
Director, Sales — Hosted Solutions | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
